_doc: The team: one Grok agent (bot) per role, all on the one Find Me Money Grok account, sharing one computer and the workspace. role: the charter in roles/<role>.md and the TRIGGER-MAP.md section. bot: the agent's name in Grok. function: the Revenue OS agent id in agents.json it is, or null for the business's own roles. created: at_install (the lead creates it, or Justin does with the message from tools/team.py), by_justin (HANDOFF Part 1), or later (with what it waits on). tools/check.py and tools/team.py read this.
account: Find Me Money's own Grok account
